prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-04-23, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-04-23):
Fiscal period 2026 Q1 (filed 2026-04-23). Revenue 22,387M, gross margin 21%, operating income 941M (operating margin 4%), net income 491M, diluted EPS 0.13. Total assets 143,724M, total liabilities 58,979M, shareholders' equity 84,113M. Current assets 69,748M vs current liabilities 34,138M (current ratio 2.04), retained earnings 39,480M.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company exhibits a very strong and conservative financial profile, characterized by low leverage (total debt-to-equity is highly favorable with shareholders' equity of 84,113M against total liabilities of 58,979M) and an excellent liquidity position represented by a robust current ratio of 2.04. While the company generates massive revenue (22,387M in Q1) and solid profitability (net income of 491M), its operating margin of 4% and gross margin of 21% indicate a high-volume, lower-margin business model that is slightly more vulnerable to macroeconomic shifts than higher-margin peers. This combination of an exceptionally strong balance sheet with moderate operating profitability comfortably supports an investment-grade rating in the upper-medium category.

DECISION: A-
